versions.changelog:
feishu-lark-cli 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive 飞书 (Feishu/Lark) instant messaging CLI capabilities.
- Supports sending, replying, searching messages; managing group chats and members; uploading/downloading images and files; managing emoji reactions.
- Provides both user and bot identity operation; detailed token/permission guidance included.
- Advanced, shortcut-style commands for common IM tasks.
- Thorough documentation of core concepts, and resource relationships for effective usage.
